name: Rachael Bevill Burns
title: Assistant Professor of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science

fitReason: Recent Assistant Professor with a substantive neural tactile-perception method and current doctoral/graduate research team. This is a lower-physical-confidence embodied-perception backup; software, tactile time-series modeling and interaction evaluation fit better than an assumed learned motor-control project.

physicalEvidence.summary: HERA uses two CNN stages to detect and classify contacts on sixteen body regions, then updates a second-order affect model. The learned inference runs on an external computer. Its live demonstration uses a real sensor-covered NAO held in a constant seated pose, while a separate monitor animates the affective response. Physical movement driven by the model remains future work. The paper’s classifier evaluations use recorded signals and real-time playback; the live demonstration is distinct. This is prior Max Planck apparatus, not verified learned actuation or current UTK hardware access. Physical score remains 0.

shortVisit.summary: The current STARI homepage invites general contact about joining the team; the official roster has doctoral and graduate researchers. Neither specifies an outside-degree visitor/intern category, duration, remote option, funding or Summer 2027 availability. This general contact text is not scored as a visitor invitation.
